svg.text: Nuitai over the Earth, to scale
The whirlpool set on the middle of the Pacific (0° N, 160° W). Nuitai is about 10,000 miles across.
Nuitai, out to the edge of the Calm Ring
Inside 2,500 miles: no ordinary ship goes here
A real place Nuitai draws from
Distances from the whirlpool are true. Toward the edge the real continents stretch sideways, the way Antarctica does on a flat map.
